product.summary: Interactive explanations of protocols, algorithms and code changes.
product.audience: For engineers and technical educators who write TypeScript.
product.description: Step through a picture at your own pace, or change a setting to follow another case. The model computes the numbers, diagrams and captions. Publish a portable HTML page with a transcript and no runtime network requests.
product.requirements: Node 24 or later and Chromium. Authoring targets Ubuntu and macOS.
